description: The capability milestones of docs/COMPLETION.md, in dependency order, as hst-decomp defines its own. tools/lbpmilestones.py measures each one; a milestone is reached only when its own criterion fully holds, and docs/milestones.json keeps the first date it was reached. A reached milestone that later measures below 100% stays in the record and is flagged regressed (REGRESSED), never hidden. Public figures follow the public tree: Sony code kept out of this repository is not counted in the public milestones. Evidence milestones are reached only by an entry in 'evidence' naming a recorded scenario. Nakagawa Recomp covers what the decompilation cannot yet: its runtime is the platform layer and its recompiled code fills unmatched functions in the hybrid builds; game-derived code never moves into it.

milestones.title: Every byte classified
milestones.criterion: every function boundary of every module in scope reviewed and every byte assigned to a reviewed region; no open candidate span

milestones.title: Game code matched
milestones.criterion: every function of EBOOT.BIN in the public scope matches exactly (tier 1)

milestones.title: All code matched
milestones.criterion: every function of every module in scope matches exactly (tier 1); in the public view, the Sony code kept out of this repository is not counted

milestones.title: PSP rebuild
milestones.criterion: EBOOT.BIN rebuilt byte for byte from source by the whole-module build (tier 2; Sony's code taken from the owner's own copy)

milestones.title: Moddable PSP rebuild
milestones.criterion: the same build still loads and runs when relocated (tier 3): the game can be changed and rebuilt

milestones.title: Every module rebuilt
milestones.criterion: every module in scope rebuilt byte for byte from source; no original binary is needed

milestones.title: Portable source
milestones.criterion: every source of the game executable compiles with a host compiler for 32- and 64-bit Windows and Android targets, against the project's PSP platform headers

milestones.title: Platform layer
milestones.criterion: every PSP system function the game imports has a complete host implementation; the platform layer is Nakagawa Recomp's runtime, measured from its reviewed import audit

milestones.title: Plays on Windows, hybrid
milestones.criterion: a native Windows build where every matched function is compiled from this source and Nakagawa Recomp supplies the rest (recompiled code and its runtime) completes the documented scenario

milestones.title: Plays on Windows from source
milestones.criterion: a native Windows build from this source completes the documented scenario

milestones.title: Plays on Android, hybrid
milestones.criterion: the same hybrid build on Android completes the documented scenario

milestones.title: Plays on Android from source
milestones.criterion: a native Android build from this source completes the same documented scenario

milestones.title: Strict 100%
milestones.criterion: every gate of docs/COMPLETION.md holds for every byte of every module in scope (tier 4)
